description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing employee attachment entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting employee attachments, with specific focus on database queries and entity management.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDao
classes.description: A DAO class for performing CRUD and query operations on EmployeeAttachment entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of partial employee attachment data for a given employee number and screen, ordered by attachment ID.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a specific EmployeeAttachment entity by employee number, attachment ID, and optional screen.

methods.name: getPartialEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a partial representation of an employee attachment based on employee number, attachment ID, and screen.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeAttachment entity, assigning a new attachId if necessary.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee attachments specified by their IDs for a given employee and screen.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Removes a specific EmployeeAttachment entity from persistence.
